title: See Every DNS Zone, on Every Platform, in One View

intro.headline: See Every DNS Zone in One View
intro.subhead: Microsoft, BIND and cloud DNS usually mean a different console each. Watch BlueCat Micetro list every zone in one inventory and narrow it to a single platform in one click. About 3 minutes.

outro.headline: One inventory across Microsoft, BIND and cloud DNS, without moving a single zone.

steps.callout: Every primary zone in the estate, in one list: 44 of them, whichever server hosts it. Nobody had to visit a separate console to build this view.
Switch the sidebar to DNS services and Micetro lists every DNS platform it manages: BIND, Microsoft, AWS Route 53 and Azure. Teams keep their platforms and gain one view.
One click narrows the grid to the Microsoft server: 11 zones, including the Active Directory-integrated ones.
Now the BIND-based MDDS appliance. Same grid, same columns, nine zones: nothing new to learn for a different platform.
Cloud DNS joins the same inventory. Eleven Amazon Route 53 zones sit next to the on-premises ones, public and private alike.
Select a zone and the Inspector shows its SOA record and properties. This one lives in Route 53, but the view is the same whichever platform hosts it.
Everything you can do with a zone is under Action, and it is the same menu for every platform. Open zone takes you to its records.
The zone's 24 resource records, A, CNAME, NS, SRV and TXT, in the same grid layout. List every zone, then read any of them, in one tool.
